Newest entry: **v3.6.27, August 1, 2026** — [NEW since the 2026-08-07 capture but HELD BELOW BAR:
security/robustness fixes, not new capability]
  - Fixed Windows certificate store loading for HTTPS requests behind TLS-inspecting proxies.
  - Edit/write tools now refuse symlink writes, preventing unintended file redirection.

v3.6.22 (Jul 29): deferred analytics startup until account status resolves.  [below bar]
v3.6.21 (Jul 29, reported 2026-08-07): Browser Preview (ACP) letting remote agents reach local dev
servers; MCP OAuth "Authenticate" button; Plan Mode in Devin Local; editable command approvals;
Cascade Migration Wizard (hooks→skills→memories); worktree sessions; custom subagent config in flat
files; subagent default model.

Updated: 2026-08-09 — one new version, no new capability.
